links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified glaucoma procedural explanations (baseline ChatGPT-generated materials at grade 16.6)
links.outcome: Reading grade level of glaucoma procedural explanations and accuracy after LLM revision
links.effect: Average reading level reduced from grade 16.6 (college level) to grade 9.4 (high school level) (p < 0.001) without reducing accuracy
links.quote: When instructed to revise glaucoma procedural explanations to improve understandability, ChatGPT reduced the average reading level of educational materials from grade 16.6 (college level) to grade 9.4 (high school level) (p < 0.001) without reducing the accuracy of procedural explanations.

links.comparator_used: Original procedural explanations without a reading-level instruction (pre-revision baseline at grade 16.6)
links.outcome: Reading grade level and accuracy of procedural explanations when ChatGPT was instructed to write at specific reading levels
links.effect: Reading level fell from grade 16.6 to grade 9.4 (p < 0.001) with no loss of accuracy
links.quote: ChatGPT successfully reduced the reading level of glaucoma procedural explanations without sacrificing accuracy, with implications for the future of customized patient education for patients with varying health literacy.

design_hint: reading-level constraint in prompts for patient education materials
